info.name: Tulis CMS Admin & Management API
info.description: Postman collection for Tulis CMS admin and authenticated management endpoints. Used for building custom dashboards and admin interfaces.

item.name: User Profile
item.description: Endpoints to manage the current user's profile and credentials.

request.description: Returns the profile of the currently authenticated user.
Updates the profile details (name, avatar) of the logged-in user.
Changes the password for the current authenticated user.
Resends the email verification link to the authenticated user's email.
Creates a new multi-tenant workspace.
Lists all workspaces the current user belongs to.
Returns detailed information of a workspace.
Updates workspace attributes and settings.
Deletes a workspace permanently.
Accepts an invitation token to join a workspace as an authenticated user.

item.name: Workspace Members & Team
item.description: Endpoints to manage members and invitations within a specific workspace.

request.description: Adds a user directly to the workspace members list.
Retrieves the list of workspace members.
Modifies a workspace member's role (admin, editor, author, subscriber).
Removes a user from the workspace.
Sends an email workspace invitation.
Lists all active invitations sent from the workspace.
Revokes/cancels a pending workspace invitation.

item.name: Content Management
item.description: CRUD operations for workspace posts, pages, and post revisions.

request.description: Creates a new content post or page.

body.raw:
{ "title": "Hello World", "slug": "hello-world", "content": "

Welcome to my new content management system!

", "excerpt": "Introduction post", "status": "draft", "post_type": "post", "taxonomy_ids": [], "feature_image": "https://example.com/cover.jpg", "custom_fields": {} }

request.description: Lists all posts in the workspace including drafts, scheduled, and archived posts.
Returns full details of a specific post.
Updates a post and auto-saves a content revision.
Deletes a post.
Lists all content revisions for a post.
Restores a post content to a specific revision state.
Registers a new Custom Post Type with schemas.
Lists all Custom Post Types registered in the workspace.
Returns details of a registered Custom Post Type.
Deletes a registered Custom Post Type configuration.

item.name: Taxonomies
item.description: CRUD operations for Categories and Tags.

request.description: Creates a new category or tag.
Lists all taxonomies in the workspace.
Gets details of a taxonomy.
Updates a taxonomy configuration.
Deletes a taxonomy.

item.name: Media Library
item.description: Endpoints to manage and upload files to the media storage.

request.description: Uploads an image or document to active storage (Local/Cloudflare R2).
Downloads and imports a media file from a remote URL into the media library.
Lists all uploaded media assets with pagination.
Gets details of a single media item.
Updates alt text and captions on an existing media file.
Deletes a media item from the database and storage.
Lists all comments across the workspace.
Moderates a comment by setting its status (approved, pending, spam).
Permanently deletes a comment.

item.name: Plugins Management
item.description: Enable, disable, and configure workspace plugins.

request.description: Lists plugins status and settings in the workspace.
Enables or disables a specific plugin.
Updates custom config settings for a workspace plugin.

item.name: Importers
item.description: Endpoints to import content from WordPress WXR, CSV files, or Strapi.

request.description: Uploads and triggers background parsing for a WordPress XML file.
Retrieves history logs of imports.
Returns detailed logs showing progress/errors of a specific import run.
Uploads a raw CSV file and returns column headers for mapping.
Triggers the background worker to parse the CSV and import entries using header mappings.
Inspects a Strapi instance and fetches available content types and collections.
Triggers a full import from a Strapi CMS instance.

item.name: API Keys
item.description: Manage API keys for programmatic access.

request.description: Generates a new API key for the workspace.
Lists all API keys for the workspace.
Revokes an API key.
Permanently deletes an API key.

item.name: Webhooks
item.description: Configure and manage outbound webhook integrations.

request.description: Creates a new webhook endpoint for event notifications.
Lists all webhooks configured for the workspace.
Permanently deletes a webhook.
Retrieves delivery logs for a specific webhook.

item.name: Analytics
item.description: Access workspace analytics and pageview metrics.

query.description: Number of days of analytics data to return

request.description: Returns aggregated analytics data (page views, unique visitors, top content) for the workspace.

item.name: AI Writing
item.description: AI-powered writing assistants for content generation.

request.description: Generates AI-suggested titles based on article content.
Generates SEO meta descriptions using AI.
Suggests relevant categories and tags based on content.
Generates AI-powered featured snippet and excerpt variants.
Creates a new membership tier with pricing and benefits.

body.raw:
{
  "name": "Premium",
  "description": "Full access to premium content",
  "price": 9.99,
  "currency": "USD",
  "interval": "month",
  "benefits": [
    "Unlimited posts",
    "Priority support"
  ]
}

request.description: Lists all available membership tiers.
Creates a subscription for a user to a membership tier.

item.name: Collaboration
item.description: Real-time collaboration locks for concurrent editing.

request.description: Acquires an editing lock on a post for the current user.
Releases an editing lock on a post.
Returns the current lock status for a post (locked by who, when).

item.name: Link Checker
item.description: Scan and manage broken links in content.

request.description: Lists all detected broken links in the workspace.
Triggers a fresh scan of all content for broken links.
Marks a broken link as resolved with an optional new URL.
Lists all users in the system (superadmin only).
Updates a user's details and role (superadmin only).
Permanently deletes a user account (superadmin only).
Lists all workspaces across the system (superadmin only).
Updates any workspace's plan and settings (superadmin only).
Forces deletion of any workspace (superadmin only).
